component.name: Aye3wm
component.summary: Black panel, flat slate blue title bars, desktop numbers

description.p: A dark style for the FlickOS desktop in the look of a classic tiling desktop: flat slate blue title bars on the window you use and grey ones on the others, thin borders, a black terminal and a near-black wallpaper.

It comes with its own layout: one black bar at the bottom with your desktops as numbered boxes on the left and the status as plain text on the right. Use sets both; you can still pick another layout in Settings.
